method.quantile: linear interpolation between order statistics (Hyndman & Fan type 7, the numpy and R default): sort the n values ascending as x[0..n−1]; h = (n − 1)·p; q = x[⌊h⌋] + (h − ⌊h⌋)·(x[⌊h⌋+1] − x[⌊h⌋])
method.move24h: m_t = |oracle_t / oracle_{t−24h} − 1| at every hour end t where both values are observed (oracle column as built: the Chainlink ETH/USD answer in force at each hour end)
method.gap: g_t = |oracle_t / coinbase_t − 1| at every hour end t where both values are observed (coinbase column: the Coinbase Exchange ETH-USD 1h candle close)
method.timestamps: hour-end UTC (price-history convention: index i opens at startTs + i·3600; value = price at the end of that hour)
